# Tracked `unsafe` surface per crate - see scripts/check-unsafe-baseline.py
# and design/generalized-safe-design.md's testing strategy section ("CI
# check, запрещающий расширение unsafe allowlist").
#
# Counts `unsafe fn`/`unsafe impl`/`unsafe trait`/`unsafe {` constructs
# (via `cargo test`'s own compiled source, tests included) per crate
# directory. CI fails if a crate's actual count exceeds the number here;
# raise it in the same PR that adds new unsafe usage, with a SAFETY:
# comment justifying each new occurrence - never as an unrelated drive-by
# change.
#
# caio-core is intentionally absent: it enforces zero unsafe at compile
# time via `#![deny(unsafe_code)]`, so there's nothing for this baseline
# to track there - a rustc error already blocks any regression.
src/caio-backend-thread 10
src/caio-backend-linux-aio 12
src/caio-backend-uring 42
src/thread_aio 0
src/linux_aio 3
src/linux_uring 4
